site.description: High impact projects in ML, systems, and applied engineering.

profile.name: Naor Tiram
profile.headline: MSc Electrical Engineering student · Computer Engineer
profile.bio: Hello, I’m Naor. I turn complex data and systems into clear, reliable software with an ML-first mindset. I focus on solid engineering foundations, clean architecture, and reproducible results.
atGlance: Target roles: Software / ML (open to related roles)
Availability: Internship or 60–80% now; full-time after graduation
Status: MSc EE student at Technion

highlights: BSc Computer Engineering, Ruppin Academic Center (GPA 90)
Coursework: C/C++, ML/AI, Algorithms and Data Structures

Rock-Paper-Scissors---Matlab.impact: Classic rock-paper-scissors implemented in MATLAB with clear game flow and input handling.
Rock-Paper-Scissors---Matlab.howToRun: Open the folder in MATLAB and run Rock_paper_scissors.m (or open Rock_paper_scissors.fig and click Run).

Image-Processing---Matlab.impact: Image processing exercises in MATLAB focused on filters and transformations.
Image-Processing---Matlab.howToRun: Open the folder in MATLAB and run C_ImagebProcessing.m, then use the Load button to pick an image.

Rummy---C-.impact: Rummy card game implementation in C++ with turn-based rules and deck logic.
Rummy---C-.howToRun: Compile the sources (e.g. g++ *.cpp -o rummy) and run the executable.

Monopoly---Cplus.impact: Monopoly game logic in C++ with player, board, and rule modeling.
Monopoly---Cplus.howToRun: Open boardGame.sln in Visual Studio and build/run, or compile boardGame/*.cpp with your C++ compiler.

Routing-data-C.impact: Simulates a simple switch with multiple input/output ports to demonstrate routing flow.
Routing-data-C.howToRun: Build: gcc "main prog.c" prog.c -o router. Run: router.exe in1.in in2.in in3.in in4.in route.txt (see files/).

CardsGameHTML.impact: Browser-based card game UI built with HTML and JavaScript.

Night-Club-app---java.impact: OOP-based management system for a night club with role-specific classes and inheritance.
Night-Club-app---java.howToRun: Compile and run: javac *.java then java NightClubMgmtApp.

MIPS-Comiper-.impact: Demonstrates MIPS compilation flow in C using instruction files and parsing.
MIPS-Comiper-.howToRun: Build: gcc mips.c -o mips. Run: mips.exe 0 0, then choose trace1.txt or trace2.txt.

FPGA-StopWatch.impact: Dual-mode stopwatch on FPGA with seconds/minutes and hundredths timing.
FPGA-StopWatch.howToRun: Open Stopper.qar in Intel Quartus, build, and program the DE0 board.

COVID19.impact: Backend API to manage COVID-19 patient records, contacts, tests, and status tracking.
COVID19.howToRun: npm install && npm start (server runs on http://localhost:3000).

Canon-ball.impact: FPGA game implementing projectile mechanics and target hits on a DE0 board.
Canon-ball.howToRun: Open the project in Quartus using FPGA_Proj.tcl, build, and program the DE0 board.

Final-Project.impact: Full-stack analytics dashboard with a Flask API and React front-end over a CSV dataset.
Final-Project.howToRun: Backend: cd Product/Back && pip install flask flask-cors numpy pandas scipy && python app.py. Frontend: cd Product/Front/final-project-front && npm install && npm start.

Block-Propagation-.impact: Simulation of block propagation over P2P networks with topology, latency, and protocol comparisons.
Block-Propagation-.howToRun: pip install -r requirements.txt && python simulation.py --protocol naive
